# Fighting for consumers
Now he's taking that fight to the Department of Insurance.
State Senator Ben Allen has spent a decade building a record of taking on entrenched interests: from the utilities to insurers to big oil. As Insurance Commissioner, he'll lower costs, bring insurers back to the market, and make sure Californians are paid what they are owed in a time of crisis.

State Senator Ben Allen has spent a decade building a record of taking on entrenched interests: from the utilities to insurers to big oil. As Insurance Commissioner, he'll lower costs, bring insurers back to the market, and make sure Californians are paid what they are owed in a time of crisis.

In the aftermath of the Palisades Fire, Ben Allen went to work — helping thousands of people who lost everything rebuild their homes and their lives. He held insurance companies accountable to pay homeowners what they were owed, pushed for faster rebuilding, and funded the brush clearing and forest management that keeps the next fire from becoming the next catastrophe.
## Ben is fighting for Californians:
1. Fighting insurers that deny and delay. Leading the fight against companies that stall claims and refuse to compensate wildfire victims.
2. A leader on wildfire prevention. A record of preparing California for the fires we know are coming - not just responding after.
3. Refuses insurance industry money. Not taking a dollar from the industry he'd regulate. He'll answer to you, not to them.
## Ben’s plan will fix the market — not blow it up.
California's insurance crisis is real: insurers are leaving, costs are rising, and families are stuck on an overburdened FAIR Plan. Ben's plan brings insurers back by increasing competition and demanding real accountability and transparency — reform that works, not an untested experiment.
Read Ben's Plan

images.heading: Ben Allen for Insurance Commissioner
images.nearby: Adam Schiff United states senator “I’ve worked closely with Ben Allen for years, and I know him to be a thoughtful, hard-working, smart, and caring public servant. The Eaton and Palisades Fires showed just how difficult California’s insurance landscape has become — and will remain — as natural disasters multiply and intensify. Ben has a proven record of tackling tough public policy issues, and I can think of no one better prepared to take on the challenges ahead, which is why I’m supporting him for Insurance Commissioner.”

images.heading: United states senator
images.nearby: Alex Padilla united states senator "Ben Allen is the kind of leader who shows up when the smoke is thick and stays until the hard work of recovery is done. I’ve seen his grit and intellect in action, working with him to defend Californians’ right to vote and support families displaced by the Eaton and Palisades Fires. Ben is a bold and thoughtful public servant with a proven track record of turning complex problems into progressive solutions, which is why I believe he is the best person to lead California through the challenges facing our insurance system.”

images.heading: united states senator
images.nearby: Monique Limon Senate President Pro Tem “Having worked with Ben Allen for close to a decade, I’ve seen him tackle difficult issues and fight for policies to help improve the quality of life in California. After the devastating fires in his district, he immediately rolled up his sleeves to help the community recover and rebuild. As someone who represents a fire-prone community, I know our next Insurance Commissioner needs proven leadership and commitment to real people, which is why I’m proud to endorse my friend and colleague Ben Allen.”

# Endorsements
###### We are strongly ENDORSING
## Ben Allen for Insurance Commissioner
Hundreds of elected leaders, organizations, newspapers, labor unions, and democratic clubs are standing together.
#### Adam Schiff
###### United states senator
“I’ve worked closely with Ben Allen for years, and I know him to be a thoughtful, hard-working, smart, and caring public servant. The Eaton and Palisades Fires showed just how difficult California’s insurance landscape has become — and will remain — as natural disasters multiply and intensify. Ben has a proven record of tackling tough public policy issues, and I can think of no one better prepared to take on the challenges ahead, which is why I’m supporting him for Insurance Commissioner.”
#### Alex Padilla
###### united states senator
"Ben Allen is the kind of leader who shows up when the smoke is thick and stays until the hard work of recovery is done. I’ve seen his grit and intellect in action, working with him to defend Californians’ right to vote and support families displaced by the Eaton and Palisades Fires. Ben is a bold and thoughtful public servant with a proven track record of turning complex problems into progressive solutions, which is why I believe he is the best person to lead California through the challenges facing our insurance system.”
#### Monique Limon
###### Senate President Pro Tem
“Having worked with Ben Allen for close to a decade, I’ve seen him tackle difficult issues and fight for policies to help improve the quality of life in California. After the devastating fires in his district, he immediately rolled up his sleeves to help the community recover and rebuild. As someone who represents a fire-prone community, I know our next Insurance Commissioner needs proven leadership and commitment to real people, which is why I’m proud to endorse my friend and colleague Ben Allen.”
#### Mike McGuire
###### Senate President Pro Tem emeritus
“I've worked hand-in-hand with Senator Allen for the past decade and he's been a tenacious and dedicated leader who always puts the needs of people first in the State Senate. We've partnered on wildfire response and prevention, holding utilities accountable, helping communities recover and rebuild after disasters and I'm excited about our work together in the years to come.”
#### Robert Rivas
###### assembly speaker
“As a leader in the legislature, I’ve seen Ben do great things, from striking deals to protect our environment from plastics pollution and increasing consumer protections for car buyers, to helping rebuild LA communities after the wildfires. Ben is tested and ready to take on the challenge of being California’s insurance commissioner. I’m proud to endorse him.”
